A '''Shining Coin''' is a {{Special}} item used as a [[Quests|Quest Item]] in the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Shining Coin''' can be obtained as a [[Floor Drop]] in the {{Purple|Haunted Biome}} in the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}.

== Usage ==
=== Gimmiegold Shard ===
A '''Shining Coin''' can be thrown in the basement of the mansion in the {{Purple|Haunted Biome}} to summon a {{MobSprite|Gimmiegold}}, which eats the '''Shining Coin'''.
